name: Mehdipatnam
place: Bus stop and Rythu Bazar, Golconda Road

reported.text: The 3 km Mehdipatnam–Tolichowki–Shaikpet stretch carries 80,000 to 1,00,000 vehicles a day and jams at all hours.
The Mehdipatnam bus stop runs many buses and sharing autos; buses stop abruptly and autos crowd the carriageway.
Named a major congestion hotspot in coverage of the 2025 TomTom index.

timeNotes.text: Commuters report the 10–15 minute stretch takes over half an hour at peak.

fix.title: Bus bay plus a shared-auto bay set back from the junction
fix.detail: Cut a 60 m bus bay into the footpath side at the Rythu Bazar stop so buses stop out of the running lane, and move the shared-auto stand 80 m back into a marked bay. Pair it with the U-turn re-spacing tested in the simulation below.
fix.agency: GHMC + TGSRTC + Hyderabad City Traffic Police

reported.text: Karwan MLA, GHMC and traffic police inspected Mehdipatnam–Nanal Nagar–Tolichowki over rising traffic chaos.
Commuters avoiding the main road cut through inner colonies, bringing them to a standstill.

fix.title: Signal retiming with a protected right-turn phase
fix.detail: Re-time the Nanal Nagar signal from counted turning flows, give the heavy right turn its own short phase and add box-junction markings so queues don't block the cross street.

name: Tolichowki
place: Under and around the Tolichowki flyover

reported.text: Both sides of the road are clogged with parked vehicles, pedestrians and sellers; the 110 ft road-widening proposal is still pending.
Vehicles parked outside marriage halls and hotels, and shoppers' cars on road edges, narrow the carriageway.
GHMC officials said congestion in Tolichowki is mainly due to street vendors.

timeNotes.text: Evening jams worsen with marriage-hall and hotel traffic parking on the road.

fix.title: No-stopping zone 100 m either side, plus an off-road vending zone
fix.detail: Mark a 100 m no-stopping zone on both approaches, move pushcarts to a vending zone on the service road, and require marriage halls to run valet parking off the carriageway on event nights.

reported.text: The U-turn under the Shaikpet flyover forces a long detour; drivers often ride wrong-side instead.
Masab Tank–Tolichowki–Shaikpet towards Gachibowli was the worst-hit road in the 22 Sept 2026 evening rain.

timeNotes.text: Evening rain coinciding with the office rush paralyses this road towards the IT corridor.

fix.title: U-turn waiting pocket under the flyover
fix.detail: Build a 40 m storage pocket in the median so U-turners queue out of the fast lane, and add a short signal phase at the turn during peaks.

name: Masab Tank
place: Masab Tank flyover and Ayodhya junction

reported.text: Traffic police flagged heavy peak-hour congestion at Ayodhya Junction and the Masab Tank flyover.

timeNotes.text: Alerted as a peak-hour choke point.

fix.title: Coordinate the Masab Tank and Ayodhya signals as a green wave
fix.detail: Link the two signals with an offset so platoons leaving the flyover arrive on green, and add box-junction markings at Ayodhya so the junction is never blocked.

reported.text: Traffic police flagged heavy peak-hour congestion on the NMDC to PVNR Expressway entry.

timeNotes.text: Alerted as a peak-hour choke point.

fix.title: Move the NMDC bus stop clear of the expressway ramp
fix.detail: Shift the NMDC stop about 100 m away from the ramp merge into a bus bay, and keep the 100 m before the ramp free of stopping, so ramp traffic and buses stop competing for the same lane.

reported.text: Among the junctions jammed during the 22 Sept 2026 evening rain.

timeNotes.text: Evening rain at office closing time brings the worst jams.

fix.title: Box-junction markings and peak signal plans
fix.detail: Paint yellow box markings and run separate morning and evening signal plans from counted flows, so queues from the Khairatabad side don't block the junction.

reported.text: Named a major congestion hotspot in coverage of the 2025 TomTom index.
Among the junctions jammed during the 22 Sept 2026 evening rain.

fix.title: Free left turn with a channelising island
fix.detail: Add a kerbed island so left-turners bypass the signal queue, and mark lanes on the approaches.

reported.text: Named a major congestion hotspot in coverage of the 2025 TomTom index.
Among the junctions jammed during the 22 Sept 2026 evening rain.

fix.title: Move bus stops 60–80 m away from the junction mouth
fix.detail: Stops right at a junction mouth make buses block the turning lane. Moving them downstream of the junction keeps the stop-line lanes clear on green.

reported.text: Named a major congestion hotspot in coverage of the 2025 TomTom index.
Motorists say junctions here often have no traffic personnel at peak hours.

fix.title: Metro drop-off bays and a pelican crossing
fix.detail: Mark auto and cab pick-up bays off the carriageway at the metro exits, and replace informal crossing with a timed pelican signal.
fix.agency: GHMC + HMRL + Hyderabad City Traffic Police

reported.text: Barricades set up for the U-turn take over one entire lane at the Begumpet junction.
Named a major congestion hotspot in coverage of the 2025 TomTom index.

fix.title: Replace lane-eating barricades with a proper median pocket
fix.detail: Cut a permanent U-turn pocket into the median so U-turners wait off the through lanes, and remove the barricades that take a full lane today.

reported.text: Diversions in place for building the Paradise–Dairy Farm Road elevated corridor (about 9 months from 30 Oct 2025).

fix.title: Work-zone lane plan with marshals and clear signs
fix.detail: Mark the narrowed lanes clearly, post diversion signs 300 m ahead and put traffic wardens at the merge points for the rest of the construction.

reported.text: Motorists say junctions in Secunderabad often have no traffic personnel at peak hours.
Water stagnated under the Clock Tower flyover during the 22 Sept 2026 rain and had to be pumped out.

fix.title: Organised auto and cab rank away from the station mouth
fix.detail: Move the queuing autos and cabs into a marked rank inside the station area, with a single exit point.
fix.agency: GHMC + SCR + Hyderabad City Traffic Police

reported.text: Motorists say the RTC X Roads junction often has no personnel regulating traffic at peak hours.

fix.title: Adaptive signal plan and box-junction markings
fix.detail: Replace the fixed plan with time-of-day plans built from counts, and paint box markings so the junction isn't blocked when unmanned.

fix.title: Bus bays and kerbside loading windows
fix.detail: Buses and goods loading share the kerb lane through the market. Bus bays plus loading allowed only before 9 am free the kerb lane at peak.

fix.title: Lane markings and no-stopping on the bridge approaches
fix.detail: Mark the bridge approaches as no-stopping and paint lane arrows so merging is orderly.

fix.title: Shared-auto bay clear of the flyover landing
fix.detail: Autos waiting where the flyover lands block the merge. A marked bay 100 m downstream keeps the merge clear.

fix.title: Heavy-vehicle lane discipline and slip-road markings
fix.detail: Mark a dedicated lane for trucks heading to the highway and clear the slip-road mouths of stopped vehicles.

fix.title: Re-space U-turn gaps between pillars
fix.detail: Use the same spacing optimiser as the Mehdipatnam pilot to place U-turn gaps between expressway pillars, cutting detours that push riders to go wrong-side.

reported.text: Named among critical bottlenecks around KBR Park where severe congestion is frequently reported at peak hours.

timeNotes.text: Severe congestion during peak hours; a permanent one-way loop around KBR Park is under review.

fix.title: KBR one-way loop, with pelican crossings
fix.detail: Back the one-way loop already on trial around KBR Park, widen the narrow stretches officials identified, and add pelican signals at crossings.

reported.text: Named among critical bottlenecks around KBR Park; officials found narrow stretches causing the jams.

fix.title: Widen the pinch point and run it as part of the KBR one-way loop
fix.detail: Take up the road widening officials identified at the narrow stretch, then run the junction as part of the one-way loop.

reported.text: Among the junctions jammed during the 22 Sept 2026 evening rain.

fix.title: No-parking near the hospital junction
fix.detail: Ambulance and visitor parking on the road edge removes a lane. Move it to a marked drop-off bay and enforce no-parking 75 m from the junction.

reported.text: More than a lakh vehicles cross the HITEC City signal in the morning.
Recorded among the most congested locations in the civic-body review.

timeNotes.text: Peak hours run 9 am–noon and again 4 pm–nearly midnight as IT staff leave and students and workers head home.

fix.title: Time-of-day signal plans and cab pick-up bays
fix.detail: Run separate signal plans for the 9 am–noon and 4 pm–midnight peaks, and move cab and bike-taxi pick-ups into marked bays off the junction.

name: Raidurg Metro
place: HITEC City road at Raidurg station

reported.text: Broad multi-lane roads abruptly narrow into single-lane bottlenecks near Raidurg, a funnel effect causing bumper-to-bumper tailbacks.
From Raidurg Metro (TGSPDCL substation) towards Dallas Center, drivers must go nearly 1 km to the HITEC flyover end to U-turn.

timeNotes.text: Worst in the IT peaks, 9 am–noon and 4 pm–midnight.

fix.title: Remove the lane drop and add a U-turn pocket near the substation
fix.detail: Reclaim the encroached width so lane count stays constant through Raidurg, and open a U-turn pocket near the TGSPDCL substation to cut the 1 km detour.

reported.text: Interchanges near IKEA Junction face extreme peak-hour traffic accumulation.
The U-turn near IKEA is cited as a long detour adding time and fuel.

timeNotes.text: Peak build-up 9 am–noon and 4 pm–nearly midnight.

fix.title: U-turn pocket with a waiting lane
fix.detail: Give U-turners a storage lane so they don't stall the fast lane while waiting for a gap.

reported.text: Recorded among the most congested locations in the civic-body review.

timeNotes.text: Peak build-up 9 am–noon and 4 pm–nearly midnight.

fix.title: Merge markings and a no-stopping zone at the flyover landings
fix.detail: Mark zip-merge lanes where the two flyover levels land, and clear pick-ups from the landing zone.

reported.text: Motorists say the Gachibowli junction often has no traffic personnel at peak hours.
During flyover works, traffic was diverted via IKEA towards Cyber Towers, doubling the 15-minute Biodiversity–Cyber Towers trip.

timeNotes.text: Rush hours reported as 9 am–1 pm and 5 pm–9 pm.

fix.title: Peak signal plans and a free left towards Kondapur
fix.detail: Add a channelised free left and separate peak signal plans.

timeNotes.text: IT-corridor peaks 9 am–noon and 4 pm–nearly midnight.

fix.title: Signal retiming from counted turning flows
fix.detail: Re-time the T junction for the dominant turning movement at each peak.

reported.text: Recorded among the most congested locations (Madhapur) in the civic-body review.

timeNotes.text: IT-corridor peaks 9 am–noon and 4 pm–nearly midnight.

fix.title: Hospital drop-off bay and no-parking
fix.detail: A marked drop-off bay at the hospital, with no-parking enforced 100 m either side.

reported.text: Recorded among the most congested locations in the civic-body review.
Part of the 8.5 km JNTU–Miyapur–Raidurg corridor being studied for missing footpaths, encroachments and auto stands.

timeNotes.text: School-zone congestion is being separated from traffic lanes in the corridor study.

fix.title: Regulated auto stand and pick-up bays
fix.detail: Formalise the auto stand into marked bays, and give school and office pick-ups off-carriageway drop-off bays, as the corridor study proposes.

reported.text: The Miyapur–Kukatpally stretch recorded higher congestion in the civic-body review.
Motorists say junctions in Kukatpally often have no traffic personnel at peak hours.

fix.title: Bus bay and metro feeder bay
fix.detail: Pull buses and metro feeder autos into bays at the station.

fix.title: Channelised merge for the Balanagar arm
fix.detail: Kerbed lane separators so the two arms merge in a controlled zip instead of a free-for-all.

reported.text: The Miyapur–Kukatpally stretch recorded higher congestion in the civic-body review.

fix.title: Bus bays at the metro terminal
fix.detail: Buses and autos meeting the metro stop in the running lane. Bays at the terminal keep the highway lanes clear.

reported.text: Financial District and Kokapet recorded higher congestion; ORR interchanges face extreme peak-hour accumulation.

timeNotes.text: IT-corridor peaks 9 am–noon and 4 pm–nearly midnight.

fix.title: Roundabout-to-signal conversion with time-of-day plans
fix.detail: Run the circle on peak-specific signal plans with lane markings for the ORR-bound flow.

reported.text: Residents say reaching Bowenpally from Suchitra needs a long U-turn detour.

fix.title: Closer U-turn gap with a waiting pocket
fix.detail: Open a U-turn gap with a storage pocket nearer the circle to cut the detour.

reported.text: Private buses pick up passengers at LB Nagar and halt mid-road; 5,605 private-bus challans were issued in 2025 up to 24 Oct.
Motorists say LB Nagar junctions often have no personnel at peak hours.

timeNotes.text: Private buses entering and leaving the city crowd the stretch in the morning and evening peaks.

fix.title: Off-road private-bus boarding point
fix.detail: Designate an off-carriageway boarding lot for Vijayawada-bound private buses, and enforce no-stopping between the metro pillars.
fix.agency: MMC + Malkajgiri Traffic Police + Transport Dept

reported.text: The Dilsukhnagar–LB Nagar stretch, already narrowed by metro pillars, is the most problematic: buses halt in the middle of the road to pick up passengers.

timeNotes.text: Private buses obstruct traffic while entering and leaving the city in the morning and evening peaks.

fix.title: Bus bays between pillars plus a private-bus boarding lot
fix.detail: Build bus bays in the gaps between metro pillars, and move private-bus boarding off the highway to a designated lot.

reported.text: Lies on the Dilsukhnagar–LB Nagar stretch named the most problematic for buses halting mid-road.

fix.title: Bus bay between metro pillars
fix.detail: A bus bay in the pillar gap at the station keeps buses out of the narrowed lanes.

reported.text: Malkajgiri Municipal Corporation plans a free-left turn at Uppal X Roads among 24 locations, and traffic police assessed movement at Uppal Junction.

fix.title: Free left turn (already planned by MMC)
fix.detail: Build the free-left already planned, with a kerbed island and clear lane markings.

reported.text: Malkajgiri Municipal Corporation plans a free-left turn at Habsiguda X Roads; traffic police assessed movement at Habsiguda Junction.

fix.title: Free left turn plus signal modernisation
fix.detail: Build the planned free-left, and bring the junction's signal onto the modernised network MMC is planning.

fix.title: Signal retiming from counted flows
fix.detail: Re-time the junction from counted turning flows, with box markings.
